name: Christmas event and map pictures
picture_standard: This is for a kids' co-op escape game for ages 8 and up: friendly, funny, cozy and a little spooky, never scary. assets.name: Christmas event

Behind them: little toy-shop houses with warm glowing windows, candy-cane lamp posts, a big lit Christmas tree, gently falling snow, a deep blue night sky.
